blocks.text: Is chapter ne dikhaya ke programs ko durust (testing aur debugging), mazboot (exception handling) aur tez (profiling aur optimisation) kaise banayein. Table is ki bunyadi istilahat ikatthi karti hai.

blocks.caption: Chapter 5 ki kaleedi istilahat
rows: Testing
Jaanchna ke program durust chale aur mutawaqqa output de
Debugging
Ghaltiyan ya bugs dhoondna aur theek karna
Bug
Ghalti ya kharabi jo program se ghalat nateeja ya ajeeb bartao karwaye
Programming error
Code ki ghalti, jaise syntax, logic ya runtime error
Unit testing
Chhote hisse, jaise akele functions, alag test karna
Test case
Program ya function jaanchne ke inputs, mutawaqqa outputs aur shartein
unittest
Test cases banane aur chalane ka Python ka built-in module
pytest
Saade, taqatwar tests likhne aur chalane ka Python testing framework
Breakpoint
Jagah jahan program ruk jaye taake variables aur bartao dekha ja sake
Watch expression
Program qadam ba qadam chalte hue variable ya expression par nazar
Exception handling
Runtime ghaltiyan sambhalna taake program achanak na ruke
Profiling
Karkardagi napna taake pata chale kaun sa code zyada waqt ya wasail leta
Optimisation
Code behtar karna taake tez chale ya kam wasail le
Performance bottleneck
Program ka woh hissa jo poore amal ko sust kare

items: Ghaltiyan dhoondein: tests (unittest, pytest) aur debugging tools (breakpoints, watches, stepping).
Ghaltiyon se bachein: try, except, finally.
Tez karein: profile, bottleneck dhoondein, optimise, dobara napein.
